item.description: - Fixed Rhino getting stuck after you let go of Fn, which made double-tap Fn feel glitchy and Rhino slow to respond.

- Rhino learns your spellings. Dictate a name it gets wrong, fix it right there (Apsumo → AppSumo), and Rhino adds the fix to your dictionary, with an Undo. Turn it off in Settings with “Learn from my fixes”. - Snippets: save a phrase like “my calendar link” and say it to drop in the full text, exactly as you saved it. - Command Mode (beta): select text, press ⌃⌥⌘C and say what to change (“make this shorter”). Turn it on in Settings. - Spoken corrections work mid-sentence: “Ship it Monday, actually no, make that Tuesday” types “Ship it Tuesday.” - Cleanup keeps your exact words on short dictations instead of rewording them. - With Fn as your trigger, Fn+arrow keys (Page Up, Home and friends) no longer start a dictation. - Setup downloads the speech model in one click, then lets you try a first dictation.

- Copy something, dictate, then press ⌘V and you get what you copied, not your dictation a second time. Rhino now puts your clipboard back the moment you paste, without making you wait 5 seconds first. - Long dictated messages are split into a greeting line, paragraphs and a sign-off instead of landing as one block.
